newsitem.title: USA: Edison Intl extends San Onofre 2 outage.
newsitem.headline: Edison Intl extends San Onofre 2 outage.

text.p: Edison International has extended for about a week the current outage at its San Onofre 2 nuclear power plant in San Clemente, Calif, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.

The NRC, in its daily plant status report, changed the status of the plant from hot to cold shutdown, citing a need to again cool the reactor to investigate and possibly repair a leaking tube in the plant's steam generator.
The unit was in a preliminary restart mode.

The 1,070 megawatt (MW) unit, shut since Nov 30 for refueling, was set to resume power production between February 22 and 28, a spokesman for Southern California Edison Co, the Edison International subsidiary that operates the plant, said last week.
Its return to service was delayed once earlier this month for repairs needed on the steam generators.
San Onofre 3, the adjacent unit, was still operating at its full 1.080 MW capacity, the NRC said.
